name: Spectrogram Waterfall
desc: A scrolling audio-waterfall spectrogram where drifting synthetic formants, harmonic combs and diagonal chirp-sweeps burn magma-hot ridges into a dark ground and cascade downward through frequency-time, driven by live FFT when present.

scale.doc: frequency zoom (feature size along the freq axis)

drift.doc: how far formant peaks wander in frequency

hue.doc: colormap hue rotation (0 offset at 25=magma anchor)
